scoring_justification: Headline quantities (S value and free-energy ordering) are produced by a full numerical optimization that cannot be recomputed in the verifier sandbox; we compare the agent's reported results against paper-derived gold thresholds and trend ordering, using threshold_or_better semantics.

hidden_assets.purpose: S target range at T=0.45 and free-energy ordering expectations across temperatures.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig. 8 (right panel) reports S=1.65 at T=0.45; Section V.B describes domain wall rotation. Free-energy ordering: C-CDW lowest at T=0, discommensuration lowest at intermediate T (0.35, 0.45), IC-CDW lowest at T=1.0, as seen in Figs. 5 and 8 (left panel).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted qualitative trends and numeric S value from paper description; S range [1.55,1.75] accommodates implementation-dependent variation while excluding arbitrary values.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's own reported results, not invented; the range is wide enough to accept any correct independent numerical optimization while still discriminating against wrong orientations.

outputs.description: Agent's computed optimal parameters and phase free energies, checked against hidden gold thresholds derived from the paper.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker verifies that the free energy ordering across the three CDW phases matches the expected physical trends and that the optimized slope S at T=0.45 deviates from √3 by a margin consistent with the paper's predictions. Detailed tolerance criteria are not disclosed.

steps.description: Slope S at T=0.45 must be within [1.55,1.75] and deviate from sqrt3 (>0.01).
At T=0.0, C-CDW free energy is the minimum.
At T=1.0, IC-CDW free energy is the minimum.
At T=0.35 and 0.45, discommensuration free energy is the strict minimum.
